newsitem.title: CHINA: Wing Shan mulls purchase of power plant.
newsitem.headline: Wing Shan mulls purchase of power plant.

text.p: Wing Shan International Ltd said on Wednesday it was in talks to buy a power plant from a China-related firm but no agreement had yet been reached.
"The company is participating in discussions with a China related third party," the company said in a statement.

"The third party is in the preliminary stages of formulating a proposal to the company which...would involve acquisition by the company of a power plant from the third party and that such acquisition might require the issue of new shares by the company," the statement said.
Wing Shan said no agreement regarding the investment sum, the method of settlement and the time schedule had yet been reached.
Trading in the company shares, which was suspended on Monday, is due to resume on Wednesday.
